insight: During the match between Ecuador and Germany, the hydration breaks seemed to have a notable impact on the teams' attacking momentum. For Ecuador, the first hydration break didn't bring any significant change in their attacking actions, but after the second break, they increased their attacking actions from 1 to 3 per minute, indicating a surge in their offensive efforts. In contrast, Germany experienced a boost in their attacking momentum after the first hydration break, increasing their actions from 1 to 3 per minute, but their momentum slightly decreased after the second break, going from 1 to 2 actions per minute. Overall, Ecuador appeared to benefit more from the hydration breaks, particularly the second one, as they were able to increase their attacking intensity and potentially put more pressure on the German team.
